companies.name: Riggs Wrestling Academy
companies.observedFact: The official registration page requires registration before attending practice and publishes a $10 cash-only drop-in fee. The homepage repeats that fee and describes recurring Monday and Wednesday practices. General registration text also mentions cash/check.
companies.opportunityHypothesis: A single practice desk could help track registration readiness, attendance and already-collected payments if those records are not already combined. The current internal software and administrative burden are unknown.
companies.verificationScope: Official published information only. Operational need, current internal process and buying intent are unverified. Retrieved search sources are cached, so confirm terms with the owner before actual use.
companies.discoveryQuestion: How do you keep registration, practice attendance and cash drop-in payments together now, and which part takes the most admin time?
companies.nextStep: Lewis reviews the independent concept, then confirms the current workflow and need with the club owner before offering an integration. No message is sent by this pass.
companies.notes: Previously recorded lead, not a newly discovered business or confirmed client. Rechecked the official published process during this bounded pass. Preserve its existing contact/opt-out state. Use only city because published addresses serve different location/parking contexts.
companies.priorityReason: A specific repeated, published practice workflow makes a small concept possible without inventing a missing website or replacing unknown software.

buildBrief.title: Practice Desk — independent workflow concept
buildBrief.purpose: Let Lewis demonstrate a possible check-in and payment-record workflow while clearly stating that the club has not commissioned it.
features: Records of payments already received, with cash as the published drop-in method
Cash/check logging kept distinct; any check flow requires owner confirmation before use
Session totals and CSV export with a visible DEMO label
acceptance: No real participant or guardian data
No external submission, outreach or owner contact
Sample payments never count as AmericanSites revenue
Changing attendance/payment records updates derived totals accurately
Clear independent-concept label and source links
buildBrief.boundary: A public website shows published policy, not the absence of internal software. This is a hypothesis to test, not a qualified sale.
